name: Mojo
use: The Mojo compiler; the mojo package builds it in Dolly

name: LLVM and MLIR (Mojo's revision)
use: The LLVM that the Mojo compiler links; mojo-llvm builds it in Dolly

name: xxHash
use: Hashes: xxhsum (GPL-2.0-or-later) and libxxhash (BSD-2-Clause), the Mojo compiler's, as the xxhash package

name: OpenTelemetry C++
use: Traces, metrics and logs for C++ programs, and the headers the Mojo compiler's telemetry interface is declared with (nothing is sent), as the opentelemetry-cpp package
